text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for inference-gateway (alert: inference.gateway.5xx_rate_high)

incident-bot: Severity: P1, trigger: 5xx rate > 8% over 2m, region=edge-east1, impacted-routes=['/v1/generate','/v1/chat'] :pager:

sre-oncall: acked and on it. I'm rolling up logs and metrics now.

maya: seeing a sudden spike starting ~10:42 UTC. 5xx rates jumping from ~0.5% to ~11% in 1m across edge-east1.

leo: on the gateway side the error type is 502 from sidecar->backend-kv, stacktrace shows timeouts. KV error rate also spikes.

product-ops: any immediate customer-facing impact? Any big customers hitting those routes?

maya: some top-key customers show elevated error rates, but not full outage. One internal test job got retries.

leo: paste logs: ```
2026-03-14T10:42:13Z ERROR sidecar request failed id=abcd1234 backend=backend-kv error="context deadline exceeded"
2026-03-14T10:42:14Z WARN kv-client get shard=42 latency=1200ms
```

sre-oncall: looks like the kv pool in us-east-2 got saturated and started timing out to gateway. Could be a hot-shard or background compaction.

maya: I can try bumping kv client timeouts temporarily and scale the kv pool. Suggest: scale kv-replicas in cluster infra-kv-east by +2.

leo: concur. Also enable a short 429 -> degrade path at gateway to prevent cascade. We can add a rate-limit on /v1/generate for non-critical callers.

product-ops: if we do a rollout, we should notify customers. Can we suppress noisy alerts while we mitigate? PD is firing repeatedly.

sre-oncall: initiating suppression window on PagerDuty for 15m while we do fixes. @pagerduty please apply.

pagerduty: Applied suppression: rule=inference-gateway-5xx, duration=15m, scope=region:edge-east1, initiated_by=sre-oncall.

maya: scaling kv: ```bash
kubectl -n infra-kv scale statefulset/kv-store-east --replicas=6
```

leo: I'm toggling gateway soft-degrade: added a throttling rule for client-tier=free: 10r/s. Config push in progress.

sre-oncall: after scale + throttling, 5xx rate dropped from 11% -> 2.1% in ~90s. Monitoring.

maya: confirming backend-kv error rate back to normal levels. CPU on kv nodes spiked but stable.

leo: removing suppression in 5m unless further anomalies.

product-ops: good. I'll prepare a short incident note for status.redwood.ai and flag customers who hit >5% errors.

sre-oncall: performing post-mortem checklist: capture logs, tag traces, collect p50/p95 latency, list mitigation steps, and owners.

maya: root-cause hypothesis: transient hot-shard in kv cluster caused latency spike, leading to timeout 502s at gateway, amplified by retries from some clients.

leo: follow-ups: (1) add better hot-shard detection/auto-rebalance for kv (2) soften retry policy at gateway to avoid retry storms (3) add an edge-level circuit breaker to fail fast for overloaded backends.

product-ops: ETA on notifications?

sre-oncall: status update -> impact mitigated, suppression active, ongoing post-mortem. Will escalate if error rate climbs again. Expected to close pager after 30m if stable.

maya: adding logs to incident doc, attaching traces for 10:42-10:46 window.

leo: quick note for runbook improvements: include an explicit step to check kv-shard distribution and an automated scale command.

product-ops: thanks everyone. I'll coordinate customer follow-ups.

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert resolved (auto-clear) after suppression window ended. Please file follow-up PM for remediation tasks. :white_check_mark:
